readers.framing: a maintainer of the library who has to implement this requirement and wants to know exactly what code to write

readings.summary: Unconditionally decorate every generated type—including formatters, string-key formatters, enum/union formatters, and resolvers—with the fully qualified ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute, without adding any setting.
readings.code_difference: The emitter must add the attribute to resolver declarations as well as every formatter declaration, using conditional emission or another compatibility mechanism where necessary, and all affected verified snapshots must change.

readings.summary: Unconditionally decorate only the generated formatter types, leaving generated resolver types undecorated and adding no setting.
readings.code_difference: Only formatter-related templates emit the attribute; resolver templates and their verified snapshots remain unchanged, so some generated code is still included in coverage.

readings.summary: Decorate all generated types by default but add an opt-out generator setting that suppresses the attribute.
readings.code_difference: In addition to unconditional generation behavior and snapshot updates, the generator must expose and honor a configuration option and provide attribute-free output when that option is selected.

output.quote: I would like all generated code to be decorated with ExcludeFromCodeCoverage attribute.  I do not feel like a setting is needed, but setting would be fine to have too.

readings.summary: Decorate every generated type unconditionally, including formatters, resolver-related types, and any other source-generator output, without adding a setting.
readings.code_difference: The attribute must be emitted across all generated type templates, including resolvers as well as object, string-key, enum, and union formatters; snapshots for all affected output must change.

readings.summary: Decorate only the generated formatter types unconditionally, leaving resolver and other non-formatter generated code unchanged.
readings.code_difference: Only formatter templates (including string-key, enum, and union formatters) emit the attribute, so resolver templates and their snapshots remain without it.

output.quote: All generated code is decorated with `ExcludeFromCodeCoverage`.
